summary.note: SKILLIFY-BATCH-001 represents 12 individual skill registrations grouped as 1 logical entry. If counted individually: 2 VALID + 3 SUSPICIOUS + 15 ILLEGAL = 20 entries, illegal rate = 0.75

systemic_findings.root_cause_confirmed: Agent memory initialization bypasses the entire promotion hierarchy. StrategicEntry can be constructed directly with confidence=1.0 and empty provenance, exactly as Phase 1 identified.
systemic_findings.primary_attack_vector: Pre-loaded agent memories (frontend-agent/memory/entries.jsonl) injected at L4 with maximum confidence, zero episodic history, zero verification, zero governance approval
systemic_findings.secondary_attack_vector: Test pipeline data (skillify/pending_registrations.jsonl) persisting as production records with fabricated evidence fields (occurrence_count, success_rate)
systemic_findings.tertiary_attack_vector: Agent decision records (agent_decisions.jsonl) storing test runs at strategic confidence without distinguishing test from production
systemic_findings.positive_finding: Guardian subsystem (GUARDIAN-STRAT-001) demonstrates the CORRECT pattern: low confidence (0.1), traceable incident chain, independent dream-replay verification, self-correction of false positives. This is the gold standard the other subsystems should emulate.
systemic_findings.enforcement_gap: The new enforcement modules (Phases 2-4) would have prevented ALL 4 ILLEGAL entries if they had been active at creation time. The write gate blocks all provenance-less L4 writes, the chain validator blocks all level-skipping, and the verifier enforcement blocks all self-certification.

cross_reference_with_phase1.match: 100% — all 3 false strategies identified in Phase 1 (FE-STRAT-001, FE-STRAT-002, AGENT-DEC-001) are classified ILLEGAL in Phase 5
cross_reference_with_phase1.phase5_additional_findings: Phase 5 additionally classifies SKILLIFY-BATCH (12 entries) as ILLEGAL and identifies 3 SUSPICIOUS entries (FE-KNOW-001, FE-KNOW-002, FE-FAIL-001) that Phase 1 flagged as OVERCONFIDENT
